content: Fǝshafǝshig nǝ Shatanah kǝ Yesu
Ngal langaan nǝ Shiɗǝkwa Daadamazhigǝl kǝ Yesu damma tǝghala, kiyava fǝshgaan kǝ Shatanaha.
Tǝhala kǝsgaana Yesu kǝ adǝla hǝng kwul uufaɗ ard vang kwul uufaɗa. Tǝhalakwaha kaa njǝkǝnjiig kǝ waiya.
Kaa sagau kǝ Shatanaha, amaa taa kǝ iina, “Magha ba zǝra Daadamazhigǝla, nǝdalnǝg ci kǝ akurǝn kǝ bruudiya.”
Kaa ngwangug nǝ Yesu amaa, “Vindavavindǝg ma kakaɗ Daadamazhigǝl taakiya,

content.text: “ ‘Dǝgzǝg kalti bi wa hǝkya shifǝga uudbiya,
bamma ǝlbǝgahi sagal vak Daadamazhigǝl baɗǝmma.’ ”

content: Kaa lanngaan kǝ Shatanah kǝ Yesu damma Wurshalima kǝss ɗyak caccuwanacaccuwana. Ngal lanngdit dat ghǝra vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla.
Aiyama taa kǝ iina, “Magha ba zǝra Daadamazhigǝla, dzǝvǝg ndan daaya. Aɗaba vindavavindǝg taakiya,

content.text: haik kǝ tsǝgaan kǝ shigahagh tǝ akura.’ ”

content: Ngugharangug nǝ Yesu, taa kǝ iina, “Vindavavindǝg dlaɓ taakiya, ‘Fǝsh bi kǝ Yaazhigǝl Daadamazhigǝlagh biya.’ ”
Ngal gwiya lanngaan nǝ Shatanah damma ghǝra aghw ba kyakkwa, kaa margardmarg kǝ iin kǝ tlǝksǝraha duni ard ndangǝrahaatǝr baɗǝmma.
Aiyam nǝ shatanah taa kǝ iina, “Ən vǝlakvǝlǝg kǝ kwanahaan baɗǝmma akwama kǝlghakǝlǝg kǝ ghwunj tǝvuukwara, agha ɓagwǝs kǝ kwatnahǝra.”
Ngugharangug nǝ Yesu amaa, “Yagh vaakwan Shatanaha, aɗaba vindavavindǝg taakiya,

content.text: ba iin pall wagha da ɓagarnǝs nǝng kǝ kwatnahǝra.’ ”

content: Kaa dagalaan kǝ Shatanaha, kaa sagau kǝ zarabǝlga ar mǝlaruwa.
Fǝgharzhafǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ ɓa tlǝraan ma Galili
Cinngha ba nǝ Yesu taaki viyavǝtviig nǝ Yuhwana, ngal dagal kǝ iin damma Galili.
Ɗuwars kǝ iin kǝ Nazarat kaa dagal da ndzǝga ma Kafarnahum, kwandza tǝvǝgh kǝ yuwahaiya, tǝ ghaala dǝ larda Zebulun ard Naftali.
Tǝdvadkwan kǝ ɗuul wa righǝvant nǝ dǝgiti tagada nǝ tlayang Ishai taakiya,

content.text: “Larda Zebulun ard larda Naftali ma Galili,
lii ndzǝga ma shiɗkwa ǝmtsǝg dlaɓa,
sǝghawisǝg nǝ parak da tǝghǝr kǝ iitǝra.”

content: Ciigǝt tǝ kwahiin kǝ sart wa fǝgharzha nǝ Yesu kǝ taa ǝlbǝg maraw taakiya, “Pǝlampǝlǝg kǝ ghǝra aɗaba tlǝkǝsǝra ghǝrazhigǝl ba hǝrza.”
Ɗahatǝrǝtɗahǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ lii vaiya kilf uufaɗa

Tǝ ɗuula dagal nǝ Yesu tǝvǝgh kǝ Yuwahaiya Galili, kaa nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ iin kǝ zarha baabah buwa, Siman kwa ɗahav dǝ Bitrusa, ard zǝra babbaan Andrawusa, ar ɓǝla amshiya vaiya kilfatǝr ma yuwahaiya, aɗaba ar lii vaiya kilf nǝ iitǝra.
Am Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Gatamkwagatǝga, ǝnda nǝkurdalnǝg kǝ lii vaiya uudah da vakara.”
Batwatsǝra ar ɗuwars kǝ dǝgaha vaiya kilfaatǝra, kaa gata Yesu kǝ iitǝra.

Tǝghǝrdǝga dagala, kaa gwuya nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ iin kǝ zarha baabah buwa, Yakuba ard zǝra babbaan Yuhwana zarha Zabadi. Ar ma pɛrayu ǝmtaɗ dǝ daddaatǝr Zabadi, ar ɓadla amshiya vaiya kilfatǝra, kaa ɗahtǝrǝt kǝ iina.
Batwatsǝra kaa ɗuugarsɗuug kǝ iitǝr kǝ pɛrayuwaatǝr ard daddaatǝra, kaa gata Yesu kǝ iitǝra.
Mǝlatǝrumǝlǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ uudah ba ɗyaka
Gwaivagwaig nǝ Yesu ma Galili baɗǝmma, tsagtǝr dǝgit ma guda dzugwazhigǝla, dlaɓa taa ǝlbǝg marawa tlǝkǝsǝra Daadamazhigǝla, mbahǝgaan dlaɓ aanji hulfa kwar kǝ kuzaha, ard lii yang biya.

Cinngalcinng nǝ ǝlbǝg tǝghǝr kǝ iin baɗǝmma ma haaya Suuriya. Kaa ba lanngaan kǝ uudah kǝ lii dǝ kuzah baɗǝmma, ard lii yangbiyah shahshaha, ard lii hǝɓa dlaɗa, ard makwayaha, ard lii ciɓǝg nǝ Shatanah baz lii ǝmtsamtsan nǝ vǝgh mbahavtǝrambahǝg baɗǝmma.
Kaa gatǝgaan kǝ dzahava uudah ba ɗyaka ma Galili, dlaɓa ard lii ma larda Dikafulis ard Wurshalima, ard lii ma larda Yahudiya baz lii gyilga zaagha Wurdǝna.
